tei:div.tei:p: "$ (283)༄༅// bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi sgrub thabs dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bklag la chog tu bsdebs pa thugs rje rnam par rol pa'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so//

(284)༄༅// na mo gu ru bud+dha bodhi satwe bh+yoḥ dri med byang chub sems mchog 'dud rtsi'i 'od// gangs can mun pa'i gnyen por spros pa na// phan bde'i chu gter dgung du bskyed bsring ba// dpal ldan a ti sha la gus phyag 'tshal// phyag na pad+ma bshes gnyen skur bstan pa// rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sras slob brgyud par bcas// spyi bor mchod nas gdams ngag ring lugs pa'i// thugs bcud thig le bcu drug 'di rmad do// bstan pa rin chen lha chos phun sum tshogs pa'i nyams len gyi man ngag thig le chen po'i dbyings su byang chub kyi sems gnyis spel ba'i zab don lag tu blang ba la gnyis/ rang don sgrub pa'i nyams len dang*/ gzhan don byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi cho ga'o// dang po ni/ byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i gnas dben par gtsang zhing dag pa'i mchod pa dang*/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma bla ma dkon mchog spyi la gcig /chos srung la gcig bcas bsham/ bde ba'i stan la 'khod de nges par 'byung ba dang byang chub kyi sems rin po che yid la byed pa dang ma bral bas sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rgyas par byas la/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir (285)mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun chen po rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyis/

skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ bsgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin tu/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po la sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma dbyung ba rnams dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ mchod pa byin brlab ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen po ngo bo (286)thub pa dang dbyer med pa'i longs sku/ g.yas nor bu'i phreng ba dang*/ g.yon shel gyi mkhar ba rtse mor sangs rgyas stong gis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa la bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs kyis sbyang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud kyi ma dag pa sbyang te stong par gyur// stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos mar me dri chang zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin zad mi shes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/

oṃ ār+ghaṃ ā hūm̐/ nas oṃ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rnams dang*/ oṃ rū pa āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ra sa āḥhūm̐/ oṃ spar+she āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs phyogs su bsdus pas kyang rung ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ bskyed pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i brtan g.yo'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems kyi cha shas las grub pa'i 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim gyi dbus su/ pad dkar 'dab ma stong ldan gyi lte bar gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab bu shu rgyan rta babs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi steng dang shar dkar/ lho ser// nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ 'og sngon por gyur pa'i kha dog so so'i rang mdog ltar 'char ba la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs can gyis bar mtshams med par khyab pa/ kha dog dang dbyibs rnams ma 'dres par so sor bkra ba'i steng gi yi ge thams cad oṃ/ shar ma/ (287)lho ṇi/ nub pad/ byang me/ 'og hūm̐ du snang ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su paṃ dkar po las nam mkhas gar khyab tu khyab ba'i pad+ma dkar po'i steng du a dkar po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa// de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las thig le dkar po nam mkha' ltar mtha' bral ba'i rang bzhin can/ de yongs su gyur pa las bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho nam mkhas gar khyab skus khyab pa/ dbu bcu gcig phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po g.yas dmar g.yon ljang*/ de'i steng gi zhal dbus ljang g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ de'i steng gi zhal dbus dmar g.yas ljang g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs pa/

spyan gsum pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ de'i spyi bor zhi ba'i zhal dmar po gtsug tor can/ rtsa ba'i phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na bgrang phreng*/ gsum pa na mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rgyun gyis yi dwags rnams tshims par byed pa/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo// g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pa na mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po thams cad mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ba spu'i bu ga re re na sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa/ de rnams ni sangs rgyas byang sems mtha' klas pa bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le gnyis pa stong gsum mi mjed kyi thig le bkod pa sngar lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na oṃ ser po las thub pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho sprul sku'i cha byad can/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad (288)pa/ g.yas g.yon tu mchog zung bzhengs te bzhugs pa/ bden pa bzhi'i chos ston cing gnas du mar sprul pa bkye nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan rang du mas pho brang de'i mtha' ngos khengs shing*/ de dag thams cad kyi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phros pas 'gro drug thams cad kyi bag chags dang bcas pa spyod par mdzad pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le gsum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhal bcu gcig /phyag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal gsum dkar po zhi zhal/ de steng gsum sngon po khro zhal/ de steng gnyis dmar po khro zhal/

de steng gnyis sngon po zhi zhal/ de steng gcig dmar po 'od dpag med pa'i dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma nyi shu na rim pa bzhin tu/ bgrang phreng dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ mchog sbyin gyi mthil na sprul sku dang*/ nor bu dang*/ lhung bzed dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ nor bu chu shel dang*/ mda' dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ phub dang*/ shel gyi gdub skor dang*/ pad+ma sngon po dang*/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ tshon sna lnga pa'i sprin dang*/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i skyabs sbyin dang*/ rin po che dung dang*/ ral gri dang*/ mdung thung dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ mkhar gsil rnams bsnams pa'o// g.yon gyi 'og ma nyi shu na rim pa bzhin du pad+ma dkar po dang*/ gzhu dang*/ ril ba spyi blugs dang*/ sprul sku dang*/ glegs bam dang*/ gzhal med khang dang*/ dril bu dang*/ nor bu me shel dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ thod mkhar dang*/ za ma tog dang*/ me long dang*/ dgra s+t+wa dang*/ bum pa dang*/ lcug ma dang*/ rdo rje tho ba dang*/ ral gri dang*/ rgun 'brum dang*/ le brgan pad+ma dang*/ zhags pa rnams (289)bsnams pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs pa/ gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le bzhi pa gnas khang gi thig le sngar lta bu'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad 'gyings pa dbu skra mthing ga dpung pa'i thad du slebs pa/ phyag g.yas shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang g.yon shel gyi mkhar ba rtse mor pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla gdan la yum chen mo g.yas su bla ma mar me mdzad/ g.yon tu rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ 'dab ma stong la sangs rgyas stong bzhugs pas mtshan pa 'dzin pa/

zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le lnga pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na a ser po las yum sher phyin ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang pos thugs kar skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon dang pos mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og mas rdo rje dang g.yon 'og mas glegs bam 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba/ zhal nas sher phyin gyi sgra 'ur 'ur ba gsung zhing spros bral du nges pa lhang lhang bskyed par mdzad pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le drug pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na muṃ ser po las thub pa bdud 'dul sprul sku'i cha lugs can/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ 'khor sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig gis bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar thig le bdun pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥdakar po las spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo (290)sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis shel phreng dang pad dkar 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar thig le brgyad pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na tāṃ ljang gu las sgrol ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon ut+pal mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'khor zhi ba'i lha mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar thig le dgu pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na tāṃ ljang nag las sgrol ma drag mo ljang nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis gri thod/ 'og ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/

'khor lha mo drag mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba// thams cad kyang hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ gar stabs kyis sa g.yo zhing bskyod pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le bcu pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las mi g.yo ba mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro zhing gtum pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sprul dang rin po ches brgyan cing glang lpags dang stag sham gsol ba/ g.yon brkyang gis tshogs kyi bdag po'i gdan la me dpung gi dbus na khro bo'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le bcu gcig pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hūm̐ dkar po las mgon po a ti sha ngo bo thub pa'i dbang po// rnam pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun tu thub pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ g.yas su spyan ras gzigs/ g.yon tu sgrol ma/ rgyab tu mi g.yo ba/ shar lhor jo bo paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha byad can/ lho nub tu 'brom dge bsnyen gyi cha byad can/ nub (291)byang du rngog dang*/ byang shar du khu ston gnyis bod ston rab tu byung ba'i cha byad can/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa// de'i thugs kar thig le bcu gnyis pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥdakar po las 'brom chos kyi rgyal po longs sku'i rnam pa can gar chas su bzhugs pa/ sku shel ltar dwangs shing gsal ba'i ngos la dkon mchog gsum gyi gzugs brnyan ji lta ba bzhin tu 'char ba/ dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can// g.yas pad dkar dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i mdun tu phyi ltar na rang dang cha lugs mtshungs pa'i khye'u dkar po bzhi/ g.yas su ser po bzhi/ g.yon tu ljang gu bzhi/ rgyab tu dmar po bzhi/

nang ltar na sku mched gsum sogs dang*/ gsang ba ltar na rigs lnga'i ngo bo// steng gi cha la brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma rnams dang*/ gsang ba ye shes sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs du ma rnams o rgyan gyi yul du mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin gar stabs sna tshogs su bsgyur ba/ de'i thugs kar thig le bcu gsum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na maiṃ ser po las rgyal ba byams pa ser po dge slong gi rnam pa can/ sku la chos gos gsum gsol ba/ mtshan dpe dang ldan pa/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas g.yon na nam mkha' dri ma med pa dang*/ btsun pa spyan ras gzigs gnyis dge slong gi cha byad can bzhengs te bzhugs pa/ steng gi cha la 'phags pa thogs med sogs rgya chen spyod brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/ zhal nas sher phyin gyi bka' zab mo rnams sgrog cing*/ de'i don la g.yel ba med bzhin tu lha'i gnas la sogs par sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'gyed cing gdul bya rnams sa lam phyin ci ma log pa la 'god par mdzad pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le bcu bzhi pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i (292)gdan la dhīḥyig gser btso ma lta bu las 'jam dpal dbyangs ser po rab byung sprul sku'i cha lugs gtsug tor can/ phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas g.yon tu jo bo dang spyan ras gzigs gnyis rab byung gi rnam pa can/ steng gi cha la mgon po klu sgrub dang zla ba grags pa la sogs pa zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams sprul pa du mar 'gyed pa/ slar yang mi rtog pa'i dbyings su yal zhing rang rang gi sku'i rnam pa lam lam 'char bas brjod pa dang bcas pa dang brjod pa med pa'i chos sna tshogs ston pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le bco lnga pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag las rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/

zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas g.yon tu jo bo dang spyan ras gzigs gnyis mchog zung longs sku'i cha lugs can rdor dril 'dzin cing bzhengs pa/ steng gi cha la nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma te lo nā ro sogs dang*/ yang sgos nor bu'i phreng ba'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le bcu drug pa sngar lta bu'i gzhal yas khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa sogs kyi rang bzhin can gyi dbus su pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid sangs rgyas chos kyi sku zag pa med pa'i ye shes can/ rnam pa longs spyod rdzogs sku skyil krung dang mnyam bzhag gis bzhugs pa ser po/ chos kyi dbyings las mi g.yo bzhin tu sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag rtsol med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i ngang nas sprul sku du mar sprul nas gzhal yas khang der gnas pa rang nyid gtso bo'i snying gi dkyil du byang chub kyi thig le dwangs shing gsal ba yungs 'bru tsam pa de rgya je cher song nas nor bu (293)rin po che'i snod rgya che zhing dpang mtho ba/ dwangs shing 'od 'tsher ba/ de'i nang du rang gi sems thig le ser po sran ma tsam dwangs shing 'od 'tsher ba mer mer g.yo zhing 'du bde rgya je cher song bas thig le rgya mtsho gser btso ma'i mdog ltar dwangs shing khod snyoms pa/ gzhi brtan pa/ rgya che ba/ khyab che ba/ gzugs brnyan thams cad 'char ba'o// thig le bcu drug gi lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dag pa rab 'byams kyi zhing khams nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/

pad+ma ka ma lā ya staṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las rang rang gi sa bon gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/

yan lag bdun pa dbul ba ni/ phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong pa'i// rnam dag sku la ye phyag 'tshal// skye gnas 'jig pas ma gos pa'i// dri med mchod tshogs 'phul lo lha// sgo gsum skye gnas 'jig bral ba'i// nyes pa'i g.yang sa mthol lo bshags// stong yang sna tshogs skur ston pas// grangs med 'dren la rjes yi rang*// smon dang mtshan mas stong pa yi// 'khor lo dbyings su bskor du gsol// skye bas stong pa'i chos sku khyed// lhun grub gnas pa'i rang bzhin las// gang du'ang 'da' bar ma mdzad cig /dge ba 'di yis 'khor ba rnams// 'di 'drar rtogs te 'di 'dra ba'i// gzhal yas khang du 'drongs gyur te// gsang sngags 'di bzhin (294)spyod par shog 'di phyin gyi sh+lo ka gsum phal cher la med pas ma brjod kyang chog /gnas skabs kri ya'i lha lnga bzhin// pad dkar stong ldan lte ba la// zla ba zhun ma'i gdan steng du// phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi// bskyed rdzogs mchog tu bsngags par shog /glo bur 'di yang chos dbyings las// tha dad ci yang yod ma mchis// tha dad med par phun tshogs pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /gtsang ma rigs kyi bkra shis shog /thog mtha' bar gsum gtsang ma las// g.yos pa med pa'i bkra shis shog /bsdu na gong gi 'phros su bzlas pa la 'jug kyang chog /cung zad spro na/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du ār+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da shab+da rā sa spar+ṣepratīts+tshahūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa rnams sbyar/ bstod pa ni/ ma dag zhing gi 'jig rten ji snyed pa// dag pa rab 'byams lha yi gzhal yas su// mngon par legs bsgyur bcom ldan thub pa che// rje btsun phyag na pad+ma'i tshogs la bstod// rgyal ba kun gyi yum chen sher phyin ma// sangs rgyas zhi dang khro bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// kun 'dus bka' gdams lhag pa'i lha mchog bzhi// skyabs mchog yi dam chos skyong rnams la bstod// rgyal chen sbyong dang zab mo lta ba'i lam// nyams len snyan brgyud gdams pa mchog gi gter// rgyun chad med par 'dzin cing spel mkhas pa// lha chos bdun ldan brgyud pa rnams la bstod// gdod nas rnam dag snang stong dag pa'i bshis// bzhin legs mtshan dpe'i 'ja' tshon rnam bkra ba// thabs shes dbyer med mi shigs rlung sems zung*// ches phra thig le'i rnam par shar la bstod// lha chos bdun gyi nying khu thig le'i chos// nyams su bstar bas tshe 'dir zung 'jug sku// mngon tu byas te don gnyis ma lus pa// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin (295)gyis rlobs/

gnyis pa bzlas pa ni/ thig le bcu drug gi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib rnams sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams 'bebs pa sogs spro ba dang bsdu ba'i mdzad pa can tu gyur par bsam pa'am/ yang na thig le bcu drug po'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog cing sku gsung thugs las 'od zer grangs med pa 'phros pas 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mchod/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs rnams byang zhing dag /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ gnyis pa la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ gsum pa la ma ṇi/ bzhi pa la ma ṇi/ lnga pa la/ ta d+ya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga to bo dhi ye swā hā/ drug pa la mu ni/ bdun pa la ma ṇi/ brgyad pa la/ oṃ twā ra tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ dgu pa la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcu pa la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcu gcig pa la/ oṃ ma hā gu ru dī paṃ ka ra a ti sha swā hā/ spro na 'khor gyi bka' gdams lha bzhi'i snying po'ang bzla bar gsungs/ bcu gnyis pa la ma ṇi dang spro na rig gsum mgon po'i sngags kyang bzla bar gsungs/ bcu gsum pa la/ oṃ mi tri ye swā hā/ bcu bzhi pa la/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃḥ dang*/ a bzla'o/ /bco lnga pa/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra bhṛ ka hūm̐ hūm̐/ bcu drug pa la / oṃ a hūṃ dang*/ oṃ dharma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams bzla/ yang na thams cad la yig drug kho na bzlas kyang chog par bshad/ 'di la grangs bsnyen tsam la gtsor mi phyed na bzlas pa'i gtso bo yig drug nyid dung phyur la sogs dang gzhan rnams ci nus su bzlas/

grangs bsnyen rab 'bum ther bdun sogs nas ma mtha' khri tsho de thig le bcu drug po so sor bzla dgos so/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ thun bsdu ba dang*/ thunamatshams kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ bzlas pa'i 'phro 'jog pa na yi ge brgya mang du bzlas la nyer bsdu ni/ rang nyid gtso bo'i thugs kar thig le ser po: (296)yungs 'bru tsam dwangs shing gsal ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lha'i gzhal yas khang la thim/ thig le bco lnga'i bar gyi lha dang gzhal yas khang de rnams kyang rang rang gi thig ler gyur nas phyi ma phyi ma nang ma nang ma la thim nas thig le ser po sran ma tsam zhig tu gyur/ de nyid sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ yang āḥl thim/ āḥyang hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yang shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems byang chub kyi thig le la thim nas stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas yun ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog /de las ldangs pa na/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ ces bsgom la spyod lam bya'o// gnyis pa gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/

rgyas par gong gi sngags man bcu drug po re re bzhin gtor sngags btags la phul/ bsdu na/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa dharma pā la sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bdun nam gsum dang*/ khyad par du jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyi srung ma dkar po brgyad cu la dmigs te/ a kā ro sogs gsum gyis phul/ slar yang*/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis phrin las bcol// (297) yig brgya brjod la nongs pa bshags/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs su gsol/ /bzang po spyod pa sogs bsngo smon rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba bya/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i bkra shis kyang brjod do// 'dir yig cha 'ga' zhig tu cung zad tsam gyi 'dra min/ thig le bzhi yi dbu ru byang phyogs kyi thig le gzhal yas khang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥdakar po las 'brom shel gyi khye'u dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa dbu skra mthing ga dpung ba'i steng du slebs pa sogs dang*/ thig le bcu gnyis par mgon po klu sgrub ser po sogs sa bon dang mngon rtogs gzhan 'dra ba dang*/ bcu drug par/ de'i thugs kar thig le bcu drug pa gzhal yas khang dbus su pad zla'i steng na hūm̐ mthing skya las sangs rgyas chos kyi sku mthing skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems thig le dkar ser rten brten pa'i rnam pa can yungs kar gyi 'bru tshad tsam 'od zer sna lnga'i rang bzhin can tu gyur/ ces gsal btab nas gnas gsum byin brlab byed pa'i lugs dang*/ yang na/ rtsa ba'i yig rnying bka' gdams glegs bam dngos su bzhugs pa las/ thig le dang po 'dra/ thig le gnyis par mi mjed kyi bkod pa yin pas thub pa nyid legs la/

yang na gtso bo thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong ngam rtsa phyag bzhi bcu bar bskyed nas ma ṇi bgrang ba'ang 'gal ba med gsungs/ gsum par rtsa phyag bzhi bcu par dngos su bstan kyang*/ yig rnying rnams su ming tsam las gsal kha med stabs/ 'di'i chog khrigs snga ma paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ lnga pa chen po blo bzang rgya mtsho/ phur bu lcog ngag dbang byams pa/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan/ dngul chu r+dharma bha dra dang lnga pos kyang thig le dang po nyid yang bskyar du bkod mod glegs bam rin po che'i yig rnying thugs dam jo bo yab sras kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gter zhes par 'di ltar bzhugs pa rtsa ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun pas legs pa/ bzhi pa gnas khang gi thig le/ lnga pa/ drug pa rnams 'dra/ bdun par phyag stong spyan stong rtsa phyag las gzhan phyag zhe gnyis nas kyang phyag mtshan du ma 'dzin pa 'khor sogs 'dra ba/ brgyad pa nas bcu drug gi bar dkyus su bkod pa dang 'dra/ 'on kyang bcu bzhi par mgon po klu sgrub mngon rtogs 'jam dbyangs ltar yod kyang gong du byams pa yod pas dkyus bkod nyid legs snyam/ sngags bcu gcig pa dang bcu bzhi par ma ṇi dang*/ bco lnga bcu drug gnyis la 'di (298) bzla zhes ma gsungs pa rnams ni khyad par te zhar byung du 'phros pa'o// gnyis pa gzhan don byin brlabs dbang bskur gyi cho ga bshad pa la gsum/ sbyor ba po khyad gshog /dbang don sgrub cing mchod pa/ dbang bskur rjes chog dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon rnal 'byor la goms pa klong du gyur pas bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor la brten kyang chog mod/ las dang po pa'i dpon slob tshogs skabs gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa nyid legs pas/ stegs gtsang ma'i khar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sgo sbrags bcu drug gi phyi ma la rgyan sogs spyi mthun ltar la/

lha gnas pad+ma 'dab bzhi bris pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i bar rnam rgyal bum pa bum rdzas nyer lngas bkang ba dang shar du las bum bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mchod pa bdun tshar bcu drug la nyung mthar byas pa dang*/ mdun du dkar mngar las bcos pa'i 'dus gtor gcig gam/ spra ོ na mgron tshan bcu drug chos srung bcas bcu bdun/ 'bring du dkar gtor cha bzhi bsham/ rdor dril/ maṇ+ḍal/ sgos 'thor nas bcas nye bar tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ bdag mdun bum gsum cho ga gcig gis mnyam du sgrub pa'i tshul bshad pa ni/ ga ོ nga smos bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i don 'brel bar mngon la/ so sor sgrub pa nyid gsang sngags gsar sa spyi lugs dang mthun la dmigs rnam gsal ba'i khyad par gyis bya ba len tu mdzad pa legs/ da ེ la'ang mdun bum chab cig pa dang tha dad du sgrub tshul gnyis 'byung ba so so'i mos pa dang bstun chog kyang lta ba'i go ba tsam dang dmigs pa yin lo tsam gyis ni byas lam bsags pa'i las su 'gyur nyen che bas/ 'di'i blo gros dman pa phal cher bde ba'i lag len ltar na lnga/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed/ gtor 'bul/ bdag 'jug go dang po ni/ brgyud 'debs dang*/ skyabs sems nas brtsam/ bzlas pa tshang bar byas nas yig brgya brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ swa bha bas sbyang / snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i brtan g.yo'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems kyi cha shas las grub pa'i 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim gyi dbus su zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par gyur bar bsam la/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon tu mdzad// mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag (2 99) byas pa// rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te// sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta e h+ye hi bha ga bā na ma hā kā ru ṇi kā dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ghaṃ nas= shab+da pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa so so la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs// oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri pā ra ār+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra ti'ats+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas= sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa bzang po las byung ba'i chu'i rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang rang gi sa bon gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ bar bsam/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha gsos la bdag bskyed ltar byin brlab bo// de nas/ phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong pa'i/ sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa sngar ltar bya/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros te mchod par bsam la/ mchod yon pa la cher mchod yon bla re dang*/ zhes pa'i tshigs bcad dam/ yang na/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// zhes pa'i tshigs bcad dam/ yang na/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin tu mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ zhes pa rnams bcug pa dang*/ ār+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñtsa ma naṃ/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ gcig ste chu bzhi 'bul/ lha yi me tog dam pa 'dis// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par (300)'tshal// thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs la// mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes shig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du bdug spos nas= rol mo'i bar dang = dhu pe nas= shab+da'i bar gyis nyer spyod lnga dang rol tsho/ zhing 'dir 'dod yon sna lnga yis/ /sogs kyi 'dod yon lnga dang*/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/

sogs kyis rin chen bdun dang*/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po ni/ sogs kyis rdzas brgyad dang*/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*/ sogs kyis na bza' dang*/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan la/ sogs kyis rgyan bdun bul ba rnams sgrub mchod dmigs su bya ba'i skabs ni mchod phreng ji tsam rgyas bzhin legs pas nges par dgos la/ dbang rkyang tsam la skabs dang bstun chog cing ma byas kyang chad skyon med/ de nas bstod pa ni/ ma dag zhing gi 'jig rten ji snyed pa/ zhes pa nas / 'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ spro zhing nus na/ rgyas par thig le so so la bstod pa ni/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// mkha' mnyam 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// stong gsum mi mjed zhing gi dpal gyur pa// thub dbang gang chen mtsho la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po stong*// spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong*// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i// btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhi 'dzum nyams ldan dbu skra dpung par sleb// g.yas g.yon phyag gis bgrang phreng mkhar ba 'dzin// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don du mnyam par bzhengs// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'brom la phyag 'tshal bstod// smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gags nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// phun (301)tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i gsung*// ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs// shākya'i gtso bo de la phyag 'tshal bstod// shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa'i bcom ldan 'das// 'gro ba kun la bu gcig lta bur brtse// lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i mdzad pa can// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// dbyings rig rnam dag pad zla'i gdan steng na// mar gad mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// lang tsho rab rgyas g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum zhabs// thabs shes zung 'brel ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs chen sdug bsngal brgyad dang 'byung po'i gdon// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa'i 'jigs pa rnams// khyod zhabs dran pa'i mod la skyobs mdzad ma// nus pa mthar phyin ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku mdog sngon po ral gri zhags pa 'dzin// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bdud bzhi rab tu 'joms// ma g.yos mi g.yo g.yo ba mi mnga' ba'i// bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras bzang po skyong*// kha ba can na dpal ldan mar me mdzad// dga' ldan gnas na nam mkha' dri ma med// dpal ldan a ti sha la phyag 'tshal bstod// yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs kyi mgon// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob gyur pa rgyal ba'i sras// rang gzhan don gnyis 'byung gnas rin po che// bshes gnyen ston pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod// byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde// mchog sde dul ba'i sde dang grags pa'i dpal// seng bzang ku sā li gnyis gser gling pa// rgya chen spyod brgyud bla mar phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jam dbyangs yod med phyogs 'jig klu sgrub dang*// zla ba grags pa rig pa'i khu byug rje// sangs rgyas dgongs skyong 'phags pa yab sras te// zab mo lta brgyud bla mar phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs rje chen po bder gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// (302)mchog gzigs te lo pa dang nā ro pa// dpal mchog ḍom+bi pa dang a ti sha

/nyams len byin brgyud bla mar phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i gzhal med dbus// 'khor 'das brtan g.yo kun gyi rang bzhin dang*// dbyer med sgrib bral ye shes chos kyi sku// rnam pa longs skur shar la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ thig le bcu drug gi lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog cing sku gsung thugs las 'od zer grangs med pa 'phros pas 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mchod/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs rnams byang zhing dag /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur bar bsam la thig le dang po'i oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa sogs thig le bcu drug po'i bsnyen pa rnams ji tsam 'os pa cha snyoms pa bzla'o/ / gsum pa ni/ bum pa sngar ltar bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul chings dang dpag bsam shing gis kha rgyan pa la sogs mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ de ltar phyi rin po che'i bum pa'i rnam pa la nang 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim gyi dbus sa ུ zhes pa nas= sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de nas spyan 'dren nas bstod pa'i bar rnams rgyas par spro na mdun bskyed bzhin dang bsdu na bdag bskyed bzhin byas rjes gzungs thag blang nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang*/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang bum pa'i lha'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa bkug nas bum pa'i nang gi chu la thim pas ye (303)shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar gyur par bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa sogs thig le bcu drug gi bsnyen pa rnams tshang bar sngar bkod pa ltar bzlas la yig brgya bzla sa te gzungs thag bsdu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ghaṃ nas= shab+da pra tits+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ ma dag zhing gi zhes sogs sam/ phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ sogs kyis bstod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ bdag bskyed ltar byin brlabs/ skabs 'dir gtor mgron spyan 'dren mi dgos pas/ lha rnams kyi ljags sogs nas phrin las bcol ba'i bar btang*/ de nas bum pa'i lha la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon phul te/ bum lha 'od du zhu bas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ bar bsam la yig brgya bzlas pas brtan par bya/ las bum du mi g.yo ba'i bskyed bzlas sam sngags tsam gyis byin brlab bo/ /lnga pa ni/ 'og gi slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i skabs ltar mtshams sbyor phal cher dor la bdag 'jug rgyas par blang ngo*/ /'dir bdag mdun bum gsum gcig car sgrub pa'i tshe/ thig le bcu pa'i mi g.yo ba las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad pa 'od du zhu nas las bum gyi bsang chu dang*/ thig le bcu drug gi lha tshogs dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad pa 'od du zhu nas dkyil 'khor bum pa dang lha tshogs bum chur gyur bar bsam nas yig brgya bzlas te bdag 'jug la 'jug par bshad do// gsum pa la gnyis/ dbang bskur dang*/ rjes chog go dang po ni/ slob ma rnams la las bum gyi chus phyi rol du khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor spyi mthun dang*/ kun slong bcos la chos bshad rgyas pa'am/ mdor bsdus tsam du/ 'o na/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i rigs drug gi sems can pha ma sha stag tu gyur pa thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/

de'i phyir du theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos kyi yang snying gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin byed kyi rim pa zab mo gsan la grol byed lam gyi rim pa rgyud la bsten par bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa bka' dang bstan bcos rnams las legs par bshad pa dag kyang tshul bzhin (304)tu mdzad nas gsan 'tshal/ de'ang rang re rnams tshe rabs snga mar legs spyad phun sum tshogs pa la goms pa'i rgyus lha las lhag pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten bzang yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di thob kyang*/ 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad mi rtag mtha' bzhi'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pas skyes pa tsam nas nges pa kho nar 'chi ba'i chos nyid dang*/ 'khrul pa'i snang bar yid brtan mi thub cing tshe la nges pa med pas nam 'chi cha med/ shi nas pha rol du 'gro ba'i tshe lha mi'i rgyal srid kyi dpal 'byor yod kyang spu rtse tsam yang khyer dbang med par gul du lus/ rang gis byas pa'i dkar nag gi las kho na rjes su 'brangs shing dge ba'i las kyis bde ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyis sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu tshan po che myong bar 'gyur bas las dang las kyi 'bras bu bslu ba med pa la snying nas yid ches dang ldan pas// spyir dge sdig la phyin ci ma log pa'i blang dor dang bye brag tu thar pa mchog gi rgyu dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa kho na la 'bad dgos/ 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang me'i 'obs dang srin mo'i gling du tshud pa ltar 'phral dang yun tu sdug bsngal chen po'i 'byung gnas las bde ba skad cig tsam yang med pas 'khor ba las rtag tu nges par 'byung ba'i blo shugs drag tu bskyed pa dang*/ rang nyid kho na zhi bde'i go 'phang la 'khod kyang ma rgan sems can mtha' dag la phan pa ma btags na drin lan ldon par mi 'gyur cing rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gdung 'tshob par mi 'gyur bas mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i byang chub chen po'i go 'phang don tu gnyer dgos/

de lta bu sgrub pa'i thabs bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi khams dbang mos pa'i bye brag gam skal pa'i khyad par dang mthun par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa stsal ba de thams cad kyang mdor bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis su 'du ba yin/ gnyis ka'ang thog mtha' bar du dge zhing nges par legs pa'i (305)lam du 'khrid pa la khyad par med kyang rang cag rnams dman pa'i lam nyan thos kyi theg pa las khyad par 'phags pa theg chen byang chub sems dpa'i gzhung lam du 'jug dgos te gnas skabs mthar thug kun tu don che ba yin/ de la'ang rgyud lam du byed pa rgya chen mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa zab mo gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis su yod pa las skabs su babs pa'i 'chad bya ni phyi ma nyid yin cing*/ de la'ang 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub rnams kyis rgyud kyi lugs gtso bor byed kyang*/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gdams ngag gi lugs gtso bor byed pa'i srol byung la/ gdams ngag la sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi ring lugs su yongs su grags pa las da lam sgrub brgyud shing rta'i bka' srol gnyis pa yin/ de'ang bod kyi yul du bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar lha bla ma ye shes 'od khu dbon gyi thugs bskyed dang brtson 'grus chen po'i rkyen dang*/ bod 'bangs skyob pa'i gnyen gcig dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po'i phrin las dus su babs pa'i rgyu la brten nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar dpal mar me mdzad dam/ mgon po a ti sha zhes sa gsum na sku che ba'i yon tan gyi snyan par grags pas khyab pa/ mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan/ byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag de nyid gangs can gyi ljongs su zhabs bkod/

thub bstan la gang zag log par spyad pa kha cig gis dri mas sbags pa rnams bsal/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa gtso bor gyur pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te bslab gsum dri ma med pa'i lam srol khyad par can phyes/ rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul khu rdog 'brom gsum gtso bor gyur ba'i gdul bya mtha' yas pa rnam par grol ba'i lam du bkod/ lha bzhis lus brgyan/ sde snod gsum gyis ngag brgyan/ bslab pa gsum gyis sems brgyan pa ste lha chos bdun ldan gyi bstan pa'i bdag po bka' gdams rin po che zhes nyi zla ltar (306)grags/ spyan ras gzigs dngos rgyal ba 'brom rin po che'i thugs sras dge ba'i bshes gnyen sku mched gsum du grags pa pu to ba rin chen gsal la bka' gdams gzhung drug gi bshad pa/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar la gdams ngag blo sbyong gi rim pa/ phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan la man ngag glegs bam gyi nyams len rnams bka' so sor babs pa las/ 'dir bka' gdams man ngag pa'i lugs kyi zab chos rmad du byung ba sprul pa'i glegs bam rin po che dang rjes su 'brel ba'i smin byed thig le bcu drug gi dbang bskur bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa bdag mdun bum pa sgrub cing gtor ma 'bul ba/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa rnams tshul bzhin tu bsgrubs pa yin da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon tu dmigs te zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ zhes mtshams sbyar la maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul du gzhug /snyims pa me tog gis bkang ba'i thal mo zlum por sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgong su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas nyes dmigs can gyi 'khor ba 'di spangs te thar pa'i yon tan thob par 'tshal bas/

slob dpon gyis de'i lam bstan tu gsol/ ces lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ ming 'di zhes bya ba/ khyed 'khor ba'i 'dam las 'da' bar byed pa'i lam thun mong ma yin pa nga las nyan par 'dod dam/ zhes dris pa'i lan gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ de kho na ltar 'tshal bas thugs brtse ba can slob dpon khyed kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gdab/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ de la thog mar lam log pa las skyob pa'i phyir/ slob dpon dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnams mngon sum bzhin tu bzhugs pa la bdag dang khams gsum gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi (307)bar du sgo gsum rtse gcig gus pas skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs bsgrub thabs kyi dbu nas 'byung ba bzhin lan gsum/ de ltar skyabs su song bas sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa mtha' dag gi gzhi rten du grub nas// lam dman pa las zlog pa'i ched du/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing byang chub chen po'i spyad pa spyod pa de bzhin tu/ bdag gis kyang mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i slad du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing de'i bslab pa la rjes su slob par bgyi'o snyam du smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i

sogs lan gsum/ spyi la sngon 'gro'i rim pa de tsam las ma gsungs kyang dbang chog kha cig tu 'dir rgyun bshags dang sdom bzung bya bar bshad pa ltar na mtshams sbyor spyi ltar spros la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags dang*/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ de nas dngos gzhi'i thog mar/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa las spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'phros pas phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thig le'i gzhal yas khang gi sgo phyes nas khyed rang rnams nang du khrid par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tsan+ḍa ma hā sogs dang*/ swa bhā ba sogs kyis slob ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang spyan ras gzigs dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas nor bu'i phreng ba dang g.yon shel gyi mkhar ba rtse mor sangs rgyas stong gis mtshan pa 'dzin pa zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba'i skur gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka dang bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis (308)phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sogs thig le bcu drug gi lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya lo ke shwa ra sa pā ri pā ra sa ma ya ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes bzlas shing spos rol dang bcas te ye shes pa dbab bo/ /des dbang gi gzhi dgod cing ye shes pa dbab pa yin la/ dngos gzhi'i don tu bstod pa sngon tu 'gro ba can gyi gsol ba lan gsum gyi rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/

skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /lan gcig gis bstod de/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol gdab/ yan lag bdun pa'i ting nge 'dzin thun mong dang khyad par ba'i don gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos/ phyag dang phyug yul gnyis stong pa'i/ /zhes pa nas sgrub thabs su bkod pa ltar la/ gsang sngags 'di bzhin spyod par bsngo/ /zhes pa'i bar bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid kyis sngags bzla bzhin par lha tshogs rnams la bskor ba byas pa'i mos pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sngags lan gsum tsam du rjes zlos dang dpon slob lhan cig pas nyer gcig sogs bzla ba phyin chad la 'gre/ de ltar byas pas thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas sangs rgyas byang sems lha dang lha mo khro bo khro mo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te rang gi steng phyogs su bzhugs/ dbang lha rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod (309)sprin gyis bar snang 'gengs/ me tog dang gur gum dang tsan+dan gyi phye ma sogs kyi char 'bebs/ lha'i rnga bo che la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa gsung bar gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod// phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam rgyas 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dam chos ldan pa thos pa'i bkra shis kyis phyug cing*// dge 'dun mi dang lha dang lha min yongs kyi gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/

/zhes pa thig le bcu drug thams cad la sbyar ba'i rjes su mdun bskyed skabs kyi bstod pa sh+tso ka so sor sbyar te/ 'dir/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa sh+lo ka gcig gi mtha' bkra shis su bsgyur/ bsdu na/ phun sum tshogs pa sh+lo ka gsum kho na'am/ bstod pa'i sh+lo ka kho na'i shis pa brjod pas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas bum pa thogs te bum chu spyi bor gtigs shing blung la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las/ hrīḥyig dkar pos dbu brgyan cing dbang lha rnams kyang khyed rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nas thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas rang nyid thig le gnyis pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i gdan la thub pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad sogs bskyed chog sa bon dor la thig le gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs brjod/ (310)bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong bar mdzad pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs gong smos ltar sbyar / 'dir bdag 'jug skabs bsdu na mngon rtogs mi brjod par/ thig le gnyis pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur par yan lag bdun pa phul bar gyur/ phyag dang phyag yul sogs sbrel ba thams cad la 'gre snying po yig drug mal du/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ thub chen rnam snang gangs chen mtsho'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ zhes pa nas/

chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las/ oṃ yig ser pos dbu brgyan cing dbang lha rnams khyed rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas thub chen rnam snang gangs chen mtsho dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phyes nas khyed rang thig le gsum pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/ lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs gsum pa'i mngon rtogs/ don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa'i spyan sdang sogs sngar ltar la sngags/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gnas gsum las sogs nas/ hrīḥyig dkar pos dbu brgyan cing dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le bzhi pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/ lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum tu mthong bar gyur pa ni sogs bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs brjod/ sngags/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ 'brom spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas gsum las sogs nas/ hrīḥyig dkar pos dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas 'brom spyan ras gzigs dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le lnga pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas lha tshogs thams cad (311)mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni lnga pa'i mngon rtogs/ sngags/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swā hā/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ yum chen sher phyin ma'i gnas gsum las sogs nas/ a yig ser pos dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams khyed rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas yum chen shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le drug pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/

lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum tu mthong bar gyur pa ni drug pa'i mngon rtogs dang*/ sngags/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ thub pa bdud 'dul gyi gnas gsum las sogs nas/ mūṃ yig ser pos dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas thub pa bdud 'dul dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phyes nas khyed rang thig le bdun pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/ lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni bdun pa'i mngon rtogs/ sngags/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i gnas gsum las sogs nas/ hrīḥyig dkar pos dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le brgyad pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/ lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum mthong bar gyur ba ni brgyad pa'i mngon rtogs/ sngags/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ sgrol ma zhi ba'i gnas gsum las sogs nas/ tāṃ yig ljang gus dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas sgrol ma zhi ba dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le dgu pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/ lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum mthong bar gyur pa ni sogs dgu (312) pa'i mngon rtogs/ sngags/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ sgrol ma drag mo'i gnas gsum las sogs nas/ tāṃ yig ljang nag gis dbu brgyan cing dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod// de nas sgrol ma drag mo dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phyes nas khyed rang thig le bcu pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/

lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni sogs bcu pa'i mngon rtogs nas/ sngags/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ mi g.yo ba'i gnas gsum las sogs nas/ hūm̐ yig mthing nag gis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas mi g.yo ba dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le bcu gcig pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni sogs bcu gcig pa'i mngon rtogs/ sngags/ oṃ ma hā gu ru dī paṃ ka rā ti sha swā hā/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ mgon po a ti sha'i gnas gsum las sogs nas/ hūm̐ yig dkar pos dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas mgon po a ti sha dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phyes nas khyed rang thig le bcu gnyis pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni sogs bcu gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs/ sngags/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas gsum las sogs nas/ hrīḥyig dkar pos dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas 'brom chos kyi rgyal po dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le bcu gsum pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/ lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni sogs bcu gsum pa'i mngon rtogs/ sngags/ oṃ mai tri mai tri ma hā mai tri swā hā/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ rgyal ba byams pa'i gnas gsum las sogs nas/ maiṃ yig ser pos dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas byams pa mgon po dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le bcu bzhi pa'i (313)gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/

lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni sogs bcu bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs/ sngags/ oṃ wā shī shwa ri muṃ/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi gnas gsum las sogs nas/ dhīḥyig dmar ser gyis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le bco lnga'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/ lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa'i mos pa ni sogs bco lnga pa'i mngon rtogs/ sngags/ oṃ badz+ra dhṛkā hūm̐/ zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi gnas gsum las sogs nas/ hūm̐ yig sngon pos dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dgyes te thugs ka'i sgo phye nas khyed rang thig le bcu drug pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du zhugs nas/ lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa ni sogs thig le bcu drug pa'i mngon rtogs brjod/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ bskor ba'i sngags/ oṃ dharma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐// zhes bskor ba byed cing bzlas pas/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas spro na dbang bzhi rgyas par bskur ba ni/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i yum bzhis rigs lnga'i dngos// bum chu cod pan rdor dril ming dbang bskur// dam tshig gsum ldan yum 'khyud bum dbang thob// bskyed rim la dbang sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen yab yum gnyis// snyoms zhugs byang sems lce yis myang ba'i mthus// bde stong skye shing gsang ba'i dbang mchog thob// sgyu lus la dbang longs sku'i sa bon bzhag

/gsang ba ye shes phyag rgyar stsal ba dang*// bdag nyid 'di shes gsum gyis snyoms par zhugs// lhan skyes bde stong skyes shing sher dbang (314)thob// 'od gsal la dbang chos sku'i sa bon bzhag /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis zung 'jug ngo sprad pas// mthar thug don rtogs tshig dbang rin chen thob// zung 'jug lam bzang bsgoms la dbang bar byas// 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon bzhag /ces bskur ro/ /de nas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi sogs nas/ hūm̐ yig ser pos dbu brgyan cing*// dbang lha rnams rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod par bya'o/

/de nas spos rol dbyangs dang bcas te bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ mjug tu dam tshig khas blang ba/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ yon 'bul rnams spyi ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rjes cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa kha gsos la/ oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta ār+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsa hūm̐ swā hā/ nas/ shab+da pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten lha sgom rten gyi thig le bzhi// brten pa yi dam thig le rnam pa drug /jo bo yab sras brgyud gsum bla ma'i lha// mthar thug byang sems thig ler bcas la bstod/ /ces dang*/ ga zhan yang spro na sgrub thabs su bkod pa'i bstod pa rnams kyang bya'o// de nas yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa ras bris yin na brten bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon yin tshe gshegs gsol bya/ dam tshig pa/ phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thig le'i snod kyi gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu/ bcud kyi lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho la thim/ de bzhin tu phyi ma phyi ma nang ma nang ma la rim bzhin thim ste/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku yang shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi ngo bo'i thig le la thim/ thig le yang je phra je phrar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ par bsam/ de nas bsngo smon ni/ de ltar zab lam thig le bcu drug gi /sgom bzlas mchod bstod bgyis pa'i dge tshogs mthus// rgyal sras sprod pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son te// 'gro kun sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /lha bzhis lus dang sde snod gsum gyis ngag /(315)bslab pa gsum gyis sems brgyan rjes dran lnga'i// nyams len mthar phyin 'gro kun sgrol ba las// rgyal ba rgya mtsho nyid dang mtshungs par shog /ces brjod/

bkra shis ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs rgyas par brjod cing me tog gi char pa snyil/ rol mo'i sgra snyan yun ring du bsgrag go /'di la rtsa ba'i yig rnying snar thang mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa nyid dbang po yin la/ da ེ 'i rjes su phyis byung kha cig dang ding sang phyag bzhes mdzad pa bka' gdams gsar ma'i yig cha gang du smos pa rnams snang ba las/ dngul chu ba dharma bha dra'i yig cha nyid 'dus gsal khyer bder mthong nas gtso bor de ltar bkod pa'o// lhag pa'i bslab gsum lta spyod dri med kyis/ /bod khams dkar por mdzad pa bka' gdams pa'i// ngo mtshar rnam par thar la longs spyad nas// thub bstan srid pa gsum du snang byed shog /tshul 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i legs bshad mang du bzhugs pas yig chas phongs par ma gyur kyang*/ gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod chen legs par bsags pa'i bcud du 'os par mthong ba dang*/ rje btsun bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rjes su gnang ba stsal ba ltar byang chub sems yid la byed pa'i ku sā li blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes/ rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gnas mchog tu bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// (316)
